title: IT Fleet
description: Mockup of an IT fleet with 41 fictional customers and about 1,200 VMs: treemap, heatmap and a bundled task inbox, all with the green, yellow, red logic of the IT Infrastructure Space.
insights: Fictional customers and VMs generated from a fixed seed, no live monitoring. A VM is green, yellow or red by the same rules as in the IT Infrastructure Space; a customer is as red as its worst VM.

Treemap: one tile per customer, area = VMs, colour = worst VM. Heatmap: customers against checks, a column with many customers points to a shared cause. Task inbox: the same task on many VMs is one bundle with one approval.
Click a customer for its VM wall, the SAP customer ID, and a button that creates a ticket for the operator through the chat tool create_ticket.
'Start demo' walks through five steps. Approving and running a bundle is simulated; nothing is changed.
prompt: Bundled example: IT Fleet (static, data embedded by npm run sync:it-fleet).
